_source: neuropeds_overnight/PREREGISTERED_review_flags_2026-10-02.md, flags_eval.py -> RESULTS_flags.txt. Rule chosen on held-out, fresh-30 scored once.
rule: Flag for review every enhancing-tumour spot of at least 50 voxels whose mean enhancing-tumour probability is below 0.7 (instead of deleting all enhancing tumour when a patient's total is under 500 mm3).

definitions.silent_false: enhancing spots shown as tumour that the expert did not mark, with no flag
definitions.silent_missed: expert enhancing lesions (>= 50 voxels) that are neither shown nor flagged
